   DENYING MOTION TO REQUEST RECONSIDERATION OF SOAH
  ORDER NO. 24 IN DOCKET NO. 59182 AND SOAH ORDER NO. 12 IN
                      DOCKET NO. 59475


      The State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) Administrative Law
Judges (ALJs) assigned to PUC Docket Nos. 59182 and 59475 issue this joint order
to address Kevin Kennedy’s motion, filed on May 12, 2026. The motion requests
reconsideration of SOAH Order No. 24 in Docket No. 59182 and SOAH Order
No. 12 in Docket No. 59475 (Motion to Reconsider), which had denied
Mr. Kennedy’s motion to continue both proceedings and granted, in part, his
request to consolidate the dockets (Motion to Continue and Consolidate).


      On May 19, 2026, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA
Transmission Services Corporation (Applicants) filed a response asserting that
Mr. Kennedy was reurging arguments already made in his Motion to Continue and
Consolidate. Applicants further argued that Mr. Kennedy was not entitled to file—
nor were the ALJs required to consider—a reply that Mr. Kennedy filed in support
of his Motion to Continue and Consolidate after the ALJs had ruled on that motion,
despite his notice that he intended to file the reply.




                                                2
                          SOAH Order No. 28 and SOAH Order No. 18;
             SOAH Docket Nos. 473-26-10397, 473-26-16349; PUC Docket Nos. 59182, 59475
       Having considered the Motion to Reconsider, Applicants’ response, and all
related filings, the ALJs find that the Motion to Reconsider lacks merit. The ALJs
had also fully considered the parties’ arguments in SOAH Order No. 24 in Docket
No. 59182 and SOAH Order No. 12 in Docket No. 59475 and will not revisit their
rulings. The Motion to Reconsider is DENIED.



Signed May 21, 2026
